title: Local GPP Gate Evidence
description: Durable no-secret artifact emitted by the local GPP AI review gate. It records whether the operator may merge a change after an independent reviewer AI verdict and a fixed set of fail-closed checks. This artifact is local operator evidence only: it does not close GPP-2, change branch protection, execute live adapters, widen support, or claim production readiness. The artifact is structurally constrained and never echoes raw reviewer evidence content.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version. Must be the literal 'local-gpp-gate-evidence.v1'.

decision.description: 'operator_may_merge' only when every check passed. Otherwise 'fail_closed'.

work_package.description: GPP work package identifier the gate evaluated.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the gate produced this artifact.

startup_preflight_passed.description: Whether the repo operating contract (AGENTS.md) and GPP status file are present and the canonical startup command scripts/gpp_next.py exits zero.

gpp_status_checked.description: Whether the GPP status file confirmed the current work package is blocked and the support/production/live-adapter guards are all false.

scope_allowed.description: Whether the reviewed scope is a non-empty changed-files list, free of forbidden surfaces in both the reviewer-declared list and the actual git diff, and an exact match for the actual git diff.

tests_passed.description: Whether the reviewer recorded a 'tests' check with status 'pass'.

secret_scan_passed.description: Whether the reviewer recorded a 'secret_scan' check with status 'pass' and recorded no secret material.

cross_provider_verified.description: Whether the implementer AI provider and reviewer AI provider differ.

forbidden_actions_absent.description: Whether the reviewer evidence is free of forbidden actions, including no 'FORBIDDEN:' finding and no true support/production/live-adapter flag.

findings.description: Gate-authored finding strings explaining any fail-closed check. Reviewer free text is never carried through; only gate-authored strings appear here. No secret material is permitted.

reviewer_findings_count.description: Count of reviewer-authored finding strings in the source reviewer evidence. Only the count is carried through; the reviewer's free text is never embedded, so a sentinel placed in a reviewer finding cannot leak through the gate output.

gpp_2_status.description: GPP-2 stays blocked. The local gate is operator evidence only and does not close GPP-2.

support_widening.description: The local gate never widens support.

production_platform_claim.description: The local gate never claims production platform readiness.

live_adapter_execution.description: The local gate never executes a live adapter.

context_binding.description: Optional GPP-2D context-binding block. Present only when the git diff was verified; absent on the unverifiable-scope fail-closed path (git unavailable or --skip-git). It binds the evidence to a specific head commit and changed-files digest so a future ao-release-gate required check can reject stale, forged, or replayed evidence. This block does not change the decision, close GPP-2, or alter the guard flags. It is optional so existing local-gpp-gate-evidence.v1 artifacts stay schema-valid; a future required check enforces its presence itself.

head_sha.description: Resolved 40-character lowercase git SHA of the reviewed head ref. A future ao-release-gate check confirms this equals the pull request head SHA so stale or replayed evidence fails closed.

base_ref.description: Trusted base ref the scope diff was measured against (the three-dot git diff base).

diff_digest.description: sha256: prefixed sha256 digest over the newline-joined sorted changed-files path list. Binds the evidence to one specific diff so the same evidence cannot be reused for a different change.

changed_files_count.description: Count of changed files in the verified git diff that diff_digest was computed over.
